news.title: Ghana wins Amputee World Cup: European Union sends message to Black Challenge
news.lede: PAY ATTENTION: Mark YEN.com.gh as a preferred source, and our content will appear higher in your Google feed! The European Union has added its voice to the wave of congratulations directed at Ghana following the Black Challenge's historic 2026 Amputee Football World Cup triumph in Mexico. The EU's official Ghana account posted on X to mark the occasion, drawing on a popular Ghanaian expression to match the mood of the country's supporters. Ghana's Black Challenge set to receive huge reward after Amputee World Cup triumph.

news.title: Ghana’s Black Challenge Win 2026 Amputee Football World Cup
news.lede: Ghana has written a new chapter in international disability sport, as the Black Challenge, it’s national amputee football team, were crowned world champions af... Ghana has written a new chapter in international disability sport, as the Black Challenge, it’s national amputee football team, were crowned world champions after defeating Morocco 1–0 in the 2026 World Amputee Football World Cup final in Mexico, delivering a landmark victory for Ghana and African football. The historic final, played on Sunday, 22 November, at San Martín Stadium in San Juan de los Lagos, Jalisco, Mexico, marked Ghana’s first-ever world title in amputee football. It also became the first time two African nations had contested the championship final.

news.title: Sports Ministry congratulates Black Challenge on amputee football World Cup victory
news.lede: The Ministry of Sports and Recreation has congratulated the Black Challenge on winning the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico. In a statement issued by the Ministry's Communication Unit on Monday, November 23, the Ministry said the victory marked the first time Ghana had won the world championship in amputee football. It congratulated the players, technical team and officials for the achievement, describing it as a moment of pride for the country. “You conquered Africa in 2021 and again in 2024.

news.title: How much Ghana will receive for winning the Amputee World Cup in Mexico
news.lede: Ghana’s top stories, now easier to find. Discover our new search feature! Ghana's Black Challenge stands to receive substantial financial rewards after clinching the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico, though the full picture of their earnings depends on a combination of private sponsors and potential government recognition. Captain Richard Arthur Opentil scored the only goal of the final against Morocco in the 32nd minute on Sunday, November 22, sealing a 1-0 victory and Ghana's first-ever world title in amputee football.
